context.intro: Belsomet is small — around a hundred homes behind the gate, on Bridgewood Drive and the courts and circles off it. On a community that size, a repaint is not a private decision. Every neighbor sees it, and it visibly resets what the standard looks like.
context.hoaNote: Belsomet runs under a community association. We prepare the design review package as part of the project, working from your association's current guidelines rather than assumptions.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Belsomet?
faqs.a: VIP exterior work starts at $4.75 per square foot of paintable surface, against a local market of roughly $2.74 to $4.89. Belsomet parcels run about 3,000 to 4,200 square feet, so homes here are closer together and paintable surface is measured on site. faqs.q: The homes are close together. Is overspray a risk?
faqs.a: It is the risk worth taking seriously in Belsomet, and it is a containment question rather than a spraying question. On parcels of this size we mask and shield to the property line, protect neighboring vehicles, walls and planting, and schedule spray work around wind rather than against it. Back-rolling on stucco also puts the coating into the texture rather than leaving it airborne.

faqs.q: My home was built in 1993 and has never been fully repainted. Where do we start?
faqs.a: With the substrate, not the color. After three decades, hairline stucco cracking is normal and does not mean anything structural is wrong — but every crack has to be opened, filled and floated to match the surrounding texture or it telegraphs through the new coating within a season. Anywhere the original coating has chalked or failed needs bonding primer before topcoat. That work is what decides whether the finish lasts eight years or three.

faqs.q: Do the canyon and city-light views affect color choice?
faqs.a: They affect when the house is seen. Belsomet elevations catch canyon and mountain light through the day and city lights after dark, so a color is being judged across a much wider range of conditions than a flat inland street. We render your elevation rather than relying on a swatch chosen indoors.

faqs.q: Can you get a crew through the gate?
faqs.a: Yes. Belsomet is guard-gated. Vehicle details and crew names go to the gate in advance and deliveries are scheduled, so nothing arrives unannounced. Materials stage on your property rather than on the street.

extraColors.note: A mid neutral that gives a 1993 elevation definition without fighting the view behind it.
